defectClosed.originalSymptom: Two REAL model refusals for a restricted topic and a non-existent topic were NOT byte-identical under identical upstream deterministic state (0 permitted hits, no restriction hint). Official Uji 1 requires PERSIS SAMA.
defectClosed.rootCause: The optional model node (N7) was allowed to own the refusal prose.
defectClosed.fix: A deterministic guard at the N7 -> N8 boundary discards ANY model draft on the refusal branch and emits the single shared UNKNOWN_ANSWER template; on the answer branch it accepts a model draft only if every figure it states already exists in the authorised citations.

nodeAndEdgeCountsUnchanged.reason: The guard was specified on the existing N7->N8 edge rather than as a new node, so every already-verified count in the evidence pack stays valid.
